# PROCESS — cand_0001 (first iteration from the seed)

Capability under optimization: **system-prompt** (`policy/policy.md`) + **tools**
(`tools/tools.py`) for the tau2-bench **airline** domain. Runtime reader:
`aws/gpt-oss-120b` (mid tier). Val: 1 task (task 8), reward 1.000, no failing
traces in focus → objective is a GENERAL robustness/generalization gain over the
whole airline distribution that cannot regress task 8.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by expected score-at-risk over the airline distribution)
No failing val trace exists, so these clusters are ranked by the airline domain's
known, policy-defined failure classes that a mid reader most often gets wrong and
that the seed tools leave UN-enforced ("the API does not check … the agent must").
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | Checked-bag miscount | book + modify-baggage tasks | nonfree_baggages mis-derived from membership×cabin×pax; wrong charge / DB state | BEHAVIORAL (deterministic) | in-body guard (both tools) + worked-example prose |
| B | Illegal payment split / invented payment id | book tasks | >1 cert / >1 card / >3 gift cards, or an id not on profile | BEHAVIORAL | in-body guard + enriched error + prose |
| C | Basic-economy flight modified / cabin changed after flown | modify tasks | policy forbids; API does not check | DECISION/PERMISSION | discriminating-predicate guards |
| D | Cancellation done when ineligible | cancel tasks | 24h / airline-cancelled / business / insurance gate not applied; judgment on "reason covered" | DECISION (partly judgment) | prose decision-chain + worked example (no code — needs judgment) |
| E | Compensation offered wrongly / wrong amount | refund tasks | eligibility gate + $100×pax / $50×pax amounts | KNOWLEDGE/DECISION | prose checklist (needs judgment) |
| F | Action done but not reported; no confirm before write | all write tasks | scorer reads final message + requires confirmation | KNOWLEDGE/CONTRACT | prose contract + worked confirm example |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | in-body guard (lever 1) | tools.py `book_reservation` | raises if `nonfree_baggages != max(0, total − free_allowance)`, free_allowance=(cabin base+membership bonus)×pax. Exact policy formula → fires only on an illegal count | yes — task 8 total=0 ⇒ expected 0 for any membership (verified) |
| A | in-body guard (lever 1) | tools.py `update_reservation_baggages` | same allowance invariant + "bags added not removed" (`total_baggages ≥ current`) | yes — task 8 doesn't modify baggage |
| B | in-body guard (lever 3) | tools.py `book_reservation` | counts payment sources from profile; raises if >1 cert / >1 card / >3 gift cards | yes — task 8 uses exactly 1 certificate (verified) |
| B | enriched error (lever 8) | tools.py `book_reservation` | "payment method not found" now lists `available=[…]` + "pass one of these" | yes — only error text changes |
| C | predicate guard (lever 3) | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` | blocks flight-segment change on a basic_economy reservation (cabin-only change still allowed); blocks cabin change when any segment status∈{flying,landed} (fail-open on lookup error) | yes — task 8 is a booking; gold never does either |
| F | enriched error (lever 8) | tools.py `update_reservation_passengers` | count-mismatch error now states current count + "cannot change number" | yes — only error text |
| A–F | prose: guide (levers 2,4,5,7,8) | policy.md | appended "Agent Operating Guide": first-steps, confirm-before-write worked example, bag-count table+formula+example, payment limits, cancellation decision-chain+example, compensation checklist+amounts, final-message report contract. Carries a scoped softness clause | yes — appends only; drops no existing constraint; binding policy unchanged |

## Verify-the-fix (guard fires only on the illegal input, never on gold)
- Bag guard on task-8 args (economy, 2 pax, total=0, nonfree=0): expected_nonfree=0 for regular/silver/gold → does NOT fire. Verified by standalone run. Fires only when the agent's `nonfree_baggages` ≠ policy value, returning the correct value → model self-corrects.
- Payment-count guard on task-8 args (1 certificate): counts {cert:1} ≤ limits → does NOT fire. Fires only on an illegal split.
- Basic-economy / cabin-flown guards: inapplicable to a booking; fire only on a genuine policy violation that produces a wrong DB state anyway, so they can only convert a wrong-write into a recoverable error, never break a compliant call (fail-open on status lookup).
- All guards RAISE (never silently auto-correct), so a policy-compliant call yields byte-identical DB state to the seed — this is why no passing task can regress.

## Process & features used
- Serial (single candidate, tightly-coupled edits to one policy + one tools file); no worktree fan-out needed for 7 edits in 2 files. Diagnosis done by reading the one trajectory + the policy + data_model + both guidance SKILLs.
- Prior iterations: none (baseline only; LEDGER/RUNMAP empty).
- tau2 is NOT importable in this workdir; validated with `python -m py_compile` + a standalone re-implementation of the bag formula on representative inputs. Could not run a full tool-registration check.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- Guards RAISE, never auto-correct → DB semantics identical for compliant calls. Keep it that way.
- The free-bag allowance table/formula is the exact policy; keep code and prose in sync.
- No existing policy constraint was deleted (prose is append-only).

## Deliberately skipped
- cancel_reservation eligibility as a CODE guard: "reason covered by insurance" is a judgment call on free text, not deterministic → left to the prose decision-chain (cluster D). A hard code guard risks false positives → regression.
- Compensation as a code guard in send_certificate: eligibility needs confirmed facts + user intent (judgment) → prose only (cluster E).
- Seat-release-on-cancel bug (logged "not implemented"): matches tau2 reference behavior; changing it would diverge from gold DB state.
